import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int btcAmount = sc.nextInt();
        int[] btcCosts = new int[101]; // Index 0 to 100
        int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
        int index = 0;
        int[] elements = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            elements[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (elements[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
            
            if (evenCount == oddCount) {
                int cost = Math.abs(elements[i] - elements[i + 1]);
                btcCosts[cost]++;
                evenCount = 0;
                oddCount = 0;
            }
        }
        
        int maxCuts = 0;
        int currentCost = 0;
        for (int cost = 0; cost <= 100; cost++) {
            int count = btcCosts[cost];
            for (int j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                currentCost += cost;
                if (currentCost <= btcAmount) {
                    maxCuts++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxCuts);
    }
}
